description: Codex: Orks (11e) SCARPER! (Runt Swarm, 1 CP) in the ENEMY's Movement phase through the real enemy_ended_move window and its reactive normal move. Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive: P1 Custodes active, P2 Orks non-active. The Custodes player clicks Custodian Guard Gamma and drags the unit 3" towards the Gretchin, then locks the move in; after the (skipped) Fire Overwatch prompt the window opens for PLAYER 2: the StratagemDialog shows SCARPER! with an enabled 'Use on Gretchin Alpha' button and the hot-seat overlay names Player 2. While it waits, the Custodes cannot end the phase. A real click on Use spends P2's CP and rolls the D6: the Gretchin (not attached, so no 6" option) may make a normal move of up to that many inches; the cap equals the rolled die. The Ork player drags the Gretchin 0.9" away and locks it in; the reactive move is recorded and the Custodes player has the phase back. Setup-only privileges: P2's detachment flipped to Runt Swarm (stratagems reloaded); Custodian Guard Gamma placed 11" north of the Gretchin; the (unattached) Runtherd moved out of the Gretchin's way.
